goal: Move pure-read GitHub API steps in seven guard workflows onto a read-only pop-ai-watchers GitHub App token with github.token fallback, so they stop exhausting the per-repository Actions installation budget; writes, locks and status posts keep github.token; no gate logic changes; generation 2: main (#3746) moved the destructive-sql, pr-object-collision and orchestrator-marker-guard PR jobs into pr-guards.yml, so the same read-token change is carried there

do not give the app token to any step that writes, locks, posts statuses or merges
do not print or commit any secret
